purpose: Replace v1 minimum effect-size rejection with a positive-direction and consistency screen for the same four selected hypotheses. All v1 files and historical rejected outcomes remain immutable.
baseline_decision_hold: Design only until E037 finishes. If E037 fails, E020 remains the proposed reference and this four-family design applies. If E037 qualifies, stop before any small-gain source/build freeze: root must prospectively reconsider the accepted baseline and source applicability, particularly whether E036 is subsumed. Do not undo E037 or construct combinations under this amendment.

replacement_gates.aggregate_gain_pct: 100*(sum_f median_i(B_if)-sum_f median_i(C_if))/sum_f median_i(B_if) > 0, using the unchanged complete-cycle timing field.
replacement_gates.paired_gain_pct: For each pair i: g_i=100*(sum_f B_if-sum_f C_if)/sum_f B_if. Median(g_1..g_16) > 0.
replacement_gates.direction: At least 13 of 16 g_i > 0. Exact ties are nonwins and remain in every calculation; no tolerance, rounded-display or epsilon-based win definition.
replacement_gates.blocks: Median of the four g_i in each of the four fixed blocks must be > 0.
replacement_gates.order_strata: Median of the eight BC g_i must be > 0 and median of the eight CB g_i must be > 0.
replacement_gates.minimum_effect_size: None. Remove v1 aggregate/paired >=1% and block/order >=0.5% gates; do not reinstate a hidden practical-size cutoff during this confirmation.
replacement_gates.fixture_guard: Unchanged: reject if any fixture median is >3% slower AND at least 9 of 16 paired fixture slowdowns are >3%. No aggregate gain overrides this guard.
replacement_gates.exactness: Unchanged full non-timing/config/state/fingerprint/stopping/checkpoint equality against the fresh reference. Three complete results and 23 convergence records per run, fixed 200/200/60 stops. Existing unit/source/custody gates remain mandatory.
replacement_gates.conjunction: Every gate must pass; no metric substitution, discretionary tradeoff, or rounded-value comparison.

randomized_order_recommendation.choice: Recommend constrained randomization of BC/CB orientations, fixed once before new measurements. Keep v1 candidate interleaving, adjacent pair processes and all pair/block identities.
randomized_order_recommendation.method: For each candidate in each block, uniformly choose one of the six permutations of [BC,BC,CB,CB]. Draw the full set once using a recorded seed/algorithm; emit and hash the complete 64-pair explicit schedule before execution. No reroll or outcome-based choice. This proposal does not draw or replace the v1 schedule.
randomized_order_recommendation.benefit: This preserves exact first/second-position balance while reducing deterministic alignment of an arm with a repeating temporal pattern. It may improve drift resistance beyond fixed alternation at negligible orchestration cost.
randomized_order_recommendation.limits: It does not remove nonlinear drift, thermal/cache carryover, process interaction or serial dependence. Chance alignment can remain. No additional cooldown, timing event, warmup, sample or statistical framework is proposed.
randomized_order_recommendation.finalization: Root chooses the amendment and ordering policy after independent review and E037 resolution; an adopted randomized policy requires one explicit frozen schedule before source/build/runtime authorization.

reporting: Report all four candidates, including failures/inconclusive cases; preserve the original selected-family size and historical-selection caveat.

Report unrounded aggregate and paired gains, absolute complete-cycle milliseconds, all 16 paired gains, win/tie/loss counts, four block medians, two order-stratum medians, all fixture metrics and regression decisions.
Report per-pair min/max and median absolute deviation, plus the block/order ranges, as descriptive observed variability only. These are not confidence bounds on the true effect.

Keep old samples out of every new decision statistic. Neither the retained 13/16 rule nor the other consistency gates yield calibrated confidence under potentially dependent observations; do not use v1 nominal p-values/alpha as evidence of significance.
Explicitly state that positive observed estimates need not imply a positive true effect; small effects can be indistinguishable from shared drift despite consistent signs.

comparison_with_v1.benefit: An observed 0.9% gain can advance if it is consistently positive; a true 1% improvement is no longer automatically rejected solely for estimating below 1%.
comparison_with_v1.cost: A tiny observed gain may advance despite little practical value. The removed magnitude margin no longer screens measurement-resolution effects; repeatability and independent broader checks carry more weight.
comparison_with_v1.finite_sample_limit: The 13/16 and every-block/order requirements remain demanding: a real positive effect can fail them. This protocol offers no power guarantee and no permission to extend a borderline cohort.
comparison_with_v1.scope: A pass only advances to unchanged broader exactness/fixture/holdout/fresh-original cumulative qualification under separate authorization. It is not adoption or a claim that true gain is at least 1%.

unchanged_rules: Retain all v1 source applicability findings, fresh per-arm builds and reference, root-only authorization, all-samples retention, no retries/replacements/extensions, no timing-based stopping, exactness/error preservation, broader qualification and no additivity. E037 remains outside this family and keeps its existing 2% gate.

official_reference.scope: General blocking/randomization rationale only; the constrained serial GPU design above is a local operational recommendation, not a statistical guarantee.
